text:
anya: Quick heads-up 1: Compliance flagged the SSO audit gap for Private deploys. Security says we can ship Hosted/Dedicated but Private needs an extra sign-off. This affects our "MVP public" definition. Need a fast scope latchback.

mike: What exactly is blocked? Is it certs, consent screens, or logging PII?

security-bot: [alert] SSO audit: missing consent capture and KMS integration for Private (ticket SEC-9912). Approx remediation 5 business days.

anya: Short: KMS/HSM integration + consent capture form + privacy review. Hosted/Dedicated unaffected. Private customers expecting GA are delayed.

liz: For launch we should split: public MVP = Hosted + Dedicated; Private = v1 (post-audit). We should be explicit in comms: "Private in beta".

rami: Agree splitting is clean. But product-customer promises: Acme contract expects Private GA. Need options to reduce fallout.

seb: Options:
- Opt1: Scope split (Hosted/Dedicated go live). Communicate Private -> v1. Owner: liz.
- Opt2: Fast-track security sprint (3 people, 3 days) to patch consent capture + KMS stub. Owner: security + infra. Cost: headcount/time risk.
- Opt3: Feature gate Private behind "early access" with explicitly limited SLA and opt-in legal addendum. Owner: legal + sales.

mike: Lay out tradeoffs in a quick matrix and vote by lunch. Please keep emojis.

```
Option | Time | Customer impact | Risk
Opt1   | 0d   | Acme upset, can show roadmap | low
Opt2   | 3d   | Might keep Acme, risk of incomplete KMS | medium
Opt3   | 1d   | Keeps Acme engaged, adds legal overhead | low-medium
```

liz: :one: unless sales push hard. We need predictable SLA for Hosted customers though; keep telemetry and rollout gating.

rami: :three: from me. Sales can push contract T&Cs quickly for Acme. Reduces engineering churn.

seb: :two: 1. I'll coordinate with infra on HSM stubs and estimate exact engineer-days.

anya: Action items: seb to give engineering estimate by 2pm; liz to draft customer comms for split messaging; rami to coordinate with sales/legal on Acme contingency.

mike: Also add milestone change: roadmap date stays same for Hosted/Dedicated, Annotate Private GA as "target v1" + new ETA TBD. I'll update the milestone tracker.

security-bot: [note] Temporary mitigation: require customer-managed KMS for Private in beta mode. Document "KMS BYOC" flow.

liz: Draft for comms done (PR opened): /docs/launch/comms/private-beta-notice.md. Pinged sales for review.

seb: Infra estimate: 2.5 engineer-days to wire in KMS stub + consent flow front-end + privacy checklist prep. If we go Opt2, recommend 48h dedicated sprint and feature-flag the HSM path.

rami: Sales says Acme will accept early-access legal addendum if we commit to a 4wk remediation SLA. That gives us breathing room.

anya: Given constraints and votes, we default to Opt1 + Opt3 hybrid: ship Hosted/Dedicated as MVP, offer Private as Early Access with legal addendum. If infra can prove 48h work, we'll re-evaluate Opt2.

mike: I'll push updated milestones: Hosted/Dedicated = unchanged, Private GA = TBD, Private EA = same launch date but gated.

liz: I'll send comms to trial customers once PR reviewed.

seb: I'll prepare the feature-flag + gating checklist and add rollback steps.

anya: Meeting 3pm today to sign the comms + gating checklist. Leave this thread open for owners to update statuses. :thumbsup:
